narrative.overview:
Creative North Star: "The Night-Shift Ledger"

A category-standard staff dashboard played straight and finished to banking-app craft (the owner's reference is monobank). The worker's money comes first: one large gold figure, its formula spelled out beneath it, one primary action, then data in calm cards. Everything sits on a warm charcoal ground taken from the supplied Tiflis logo, tuned for a phone held in one hand in a dim restaurant hall. The ground is dark only: the owner rejected a light theme for evening use.

The system carries no themed ornament: no wine, menu, Georgian folklore or other motifs, and no gradients, glows or patterns. Character comes from the brand pair (charcoal and gold), confident tabular numbers in one sans, tonal surface steps, and generous 14–20px radii. Gold is scarce and always means something: your money, your learning progress, your action, your current selection.

Migration state. The cash screen (`src/pages/CashPage.tsx`, `src/components/CashTopList.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/cash-v3.css`) was the first screen built on this system. The schedule screen (`src/pages/SchedulePage.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/schedule-v3.css`) is the second. The home page («Сьогодні», `src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/home-v3.css`) is the third, and it carries the system's one page-scoped exception: the gold masthead (see The Gold Is Earned Rule). The menu («Меню ресторану», `src/pages/MenuPage.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/menu-v3.css`) is the fourth: a study guide for waiters in three modes, Довідник / Тренажер / План, switched by a three-segment radiogroup segmented control. Its teaching fields and per-person progress come from the `menu_learning` migration and the `tiflis-menu-api` edge function. Personnel («Персонал», `src/pages/StaffPage.tsx` and `src/pages/StaffBirthdaysTab.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/staff-v3.css` and `src/pages/staff-birthdays.css`) is the fifth: «хто є хто» as a wall of faces grouped by role, with a two-segment Команда / Дні народження switch and, for admins, a gold «Новий працівник» button beside it. Its data and account actions come from the `tiflis-staff-api` edge function. Reservations («Резерви», `src/pages/ReservePage.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/reserve-v3.css`) is the sixth: the hostess desk, a day strip over a time-grouped agenda with one-tap arrival actions, a «Схема залу» floor view of one hall at a time, and a booking form in the order of a phone call that suggests free tables. Its data, availability and status changes come from the `tiflis-reserve-api` edge function. Records («Рекорди», `src/pages/RecordsPage.tsx`, styles in `src/pages/records-v3.css`) is the seventh: a hall of fame for waiters, switched by a two-segment Дошка слави / Мої рекорди control, with a gold «Хто лідирує цього місяця — у Касі» link and a chevron that deep-links to the live race at `/cash?tab=top`. The Дошка слави is one plaque per record with the holder large and places 2–5 beneath; Мої рекорди turns every record into a place and a distance («до рекорду …»), and waiters enter their own manual records. Its data comes from the `records_*` actions of the `tiflis-secure-api` edge function. The portal tokens (`--t-*`) live in `src/theme/tiflis-theme.css`, which loads last and also rethemes the shared shell (sidebar, top bar, mobile bottom nav, avatars). Every other screen still carries legacy styles: hard-coded greens from the old portal, Prata headings, and older panel patterns. As a bridge, the legacy token names (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--surface-2`, `--surface-3`, `--surface-raised`, `--border`, `--border-strong`, `--text`, `--muted`, `--gold`, `--gold-soft`, `--green`, `--danger`) now resolve to the `--t-*` values, so older screens get the brand ground without being redesigned. The bridge is temporary. When you migrate a screen, use the `--t-*` tokens and the cash-v3 component patterns below, and remove its hard-coded colours and Prata. Don't add new uses of the legacy names.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal ground with three tonal surface steps; depth comes from tone, not shadow.
Brand gold (#D1B46B) used sparingly, only for meaning.
One self-hosted UI sans (Golos Text, 400–700), tabular figures everywhere money appears.
Summary first, one gold primary action per view, data in rounded cards.
Phone-first single column, which becomes a two-column dashboard at 1024px (Home splits at 981px).
One page-scoped exception: the Home masthead is a flat gold field carrying the charcoal wordmark. Gold is a background nowhere else.
Green and red only for gain and loss, always paired with an arrow or sign.
Dense team data stays a people × days table; today and the viewer are marked in place with a faint gold haze, never reordered.
Reference content (the menu) reads in one left-aligned 880px column in line with the page title; allergens are a coral warning, and the viewer's own learning progress is gold.
People are faces first: the team is a wall of square portraits grouped in hall order, each opening a profile sheet; account state is quiet admin-only text, never a badge.
The hostess desk reads the day by time: bookings are cards under their time, arrival is one tap, a seated table is gain green, and the phone-call form proposes free tables instead of asking for one.

Records are a hall of fame, not a second race: one plaque per record with the holder large, a gold trophy beside the holder, tied values sharing a place, and a personal view that reads each record as a place and a distance. The live monthly race stays on Каса · Топ.

rules.name: The Gold Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold marks money that belongs to the viewer, the viewer's own learning progress (the «знаю» mark, progress bars and completed lessons on the menu), the viewer themself in a list of people (the «Ти» badge, the gold ring in the team strip, and «Це ти» with an inset gold hairline on their own face tile), the one primary action, or the current selection. It is never a background wash for a section, a decorative border, or a heading colour. The one exception is the Home masthead: on the home page only, a flat gold (#D1B46B) field carries the charcoal wordmark, the date and time, and the greeting, with all text in ink on gold (`--t-on-gold`). It stays flat (no gradient, tint, texture or shadow), and no other page, section or card may use gold as its background. Reservations adds one state use, scoped to the «Схема залу» floor tiles: a table with a live booking (waiting, not yet seated) wears a 1px gold border, the 12% gold wash and its booking time in gold. It marks a single table tile, never a card, section or list row, and it is never the solid gold fill. Everywhere else on that page gold keeps the meanings above: the primary action and the current selection. Records adds one meaning, scoped to that page: a 14px gold trophy beside the name of whoever holds a restaurant record, and the «Рекорд ресторану» badge (gold on the gold wash, with the trophy) when the person being viewed holds it. Everything else gold on Records is the viewer (the «Ти» pill, the viewer's own name and rank, the place figure in «Твоє місце N»), the one primary action («Зберегти»), or the text link to the live race. Places 2–5 carry no podium or medal colours.

rules.name: The Green Means Gain Rule
rules.body: Green and coral appear only for movement and consequence (gain, loss, delete, error) and always with an arrow, sign or word next to them. Green is never a brand or success-decoration colour. This rule retires the old green-era palette. The one outcome use is a seated booking on Reservations: guests who arrived are the good outcome, so the «За столом» state pill is gain green text with a check, and the seated floor tile is a 22% gain-green mix into charcoal surface with «за столом» written on it. Waiting, closed, cancelled and no-show bookings carry no green, and green never becomes a button or a success toast.

rules.name: The Allergen Warning Rule
rules.body: Allergens are a warning, so they wear the loss coral tint: each allergen is named in words in coral text on coral wash, under an «Алергени» heading, in the dish sheet, the trainer answer and the editor's picked allergens. The draft flag uses the same warning sense as a small coral alert icon on a neutral note. This is coral's one warning use beyond movement and consequence. It is not a category and not decoration, and it does not change what green may do (see The Green Means Gain Rule).

rules.name: The Closed Legend Rule
rules.body: Shift-code colours are a closed legend: every coloured code shows its letters, and the screen shows the legend. Inside that legend, gold on gold wash means breakfasts and coral on coral wash means leave; this is the only place gold and coral carry a category instead of the meanings above. Never borrow the code tints, or the cool bar blue, for anything else. Coral wash is not the legend's property: outside it, it keeps its warning sense for alerts and allergens (see The Allergen Warning Rule).

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every screen showing sums sets `tabular-nums`. Amounts are formatted uk-UA (space-grouped thousands) with a trailing ₴, so columns of money line up.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Golos Text is the only interface face. Prata and system display faces belong to the legacy screens and are removed during migration.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: To raise something, move it one step up the surface ramp. Don't add a drop shadow, glow or gradient. The summary card sits on brand charcoal, while ordinary cards sit one step lower with a hairline border.

rules.name: The Flag Not Hide Rule
rules.body: A dish whose teaching text is unreviewed (`learning_reviewed` false) is always shown, with the draft note, never hidden. Changing the teaching text (what it is, the guest line, pairing) or the allergens of a reviewed dish returns it to draft until the kitchen ticks «Перевірено кухнею» again.

rules.name: The Reference Only Rule
rules.body: Bar and wine are reference only: they appear in the Довідник with мл volumes, but have no lessons, no trainer deck and no «Знаю цю страву» button. The plan covers the kitchen and the seasonal menu.

rules.name: The Open Dialog Rule
rules.body: While a dialog is open, the page behind it is inert, so anything that happens because of the dialog reports inside it: form problems below the fields in coral text, failed actions (archive, password reset, save, delete) in a coral-wash note in the sheet, never in a page alert the user cannot reach.

rules.name: The Admin Only Account Rule
rules.body: Account state (the login, whether the person has signed in, and the archive) is for admins only, and it is enforced in `tiflis-staff-api`, not just hidden: for everyone else the API blanks the login and sign-in state and leaves archived people out. In the interface it is quiet text, never a badge or tile.

rules.name: The One Birthday Rule
rules.body: A person has one birthday. Saving a birthday on a staff profile updates the linked row in the birthday roster (which also drives the Telegram reminder), so the profile and the roster never disagree.

rules.name: The One Overlap Rule
rules.body: The client and `tiflis-reserve-api` share one overlap rule: two bookings collide when they share a table label (the primary table or a merged one) in the same hall and day, and each starts before the other ends. A missing duration counts as 2 hours. A seated booking on today's date blocks its tables until at least now + 15 minutes, on the Kyiv clock (Europe/Kyiv), however long it was booked for. The form computes free tables with this rule; the server repeats it on every save and answers a collision with a 409.

rules.name: The Status Only Rule
rules.body: Arrival and closing taps call `reserve_status`, which changes only the status, so a tap never overwrites an edit someone else saved. Closing a booking (left, cancelled, no-show) never conflicts. Seating or reopening a closed booking must still fit its table under The One Overlap Rule.

rules.name: The Occasion Marker Rule
rules.body: Occasions are stored in the booking's note, as its first line, behind the marker «Привід: », joined by « · » («Привід: День народження · Свій торт»); the free text follows on the next lines. Only that first line is read back as tags, and only known occasions, so free text that resembles a tag is never mistaken for one, and a waiter reading the raw note elsewhere still understands it.

rules.name: The Pressed Pill Rule
rules.body: Pill choices (day chips, hall chips, the view switch, date, time, duration, party size, table, merge and occasion pills) are `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed` inside a labelled `role="group"`, never unmanaged radio inputs. The selected one is gold on the gold wash; occasion and merge pills toggle independently.

rules.name: The Shared Place Rule
rules.body: Equal values share a place, in competition ranking: 1, 1, 3. The server numbers rows sequentially (1, 2, 3), so the client recomputes places from the top five: a row's place is one plus the number of rows with a strictly greater value. Everyone on the best value holds the record together (co-holders on the plaque, and the «Рекорд ресторану» badge in Мої рекорди), and nobody on the best value is ever called «2 місце». A value of zero holds nothing.

rules.name: The Server Halves Rule
rules.body: Half-month records and the cash top follow one split, computed in `tiflis-secure-api`: 1–15 and 16–end, labelled «1–15 серпня 2026» and «16–31 серпня 2026», the same split as the schedule, so the dates shown always match the sum. Records count the immutable `first_cash`, like the cash top, and tied values share a place (1, 2, 2, 4), with whoever reached the value first listed first. The one exception is payroll: the cash overview pays out cash for 1–14 and the rate and extras for 1–15, and says so in its note.

rules.name: The Open Records Rule
rules.body: On Рекорди every waiter's record value is visible to every waiter, money included (best month and half-month cash, largest tip), on the plaques and in their top five. This is the owner's exception to the privacy rule, recorded in PRODUCT.md («Owner exception (November 2026): Рекорди»), chosen for the competition. It is scoped to this screen: the live Каса · Топ, and every other ranking or shared view, still shows place and movement only, never other people's sums. The board covers waiters only.

dos: Do build migrated screens on the `--t-*` tokens and the cash-v3 patterns (hero summary, stat tiles, segmented control, cards, hairline lists, dialog).
Do keep gold for the viewer's money, the viewer's own learning progress, the single primary action, and the current selection (The Gold Is Earned Rule).
Do show sums with `tabular-nums`, uk-UA grouping and a trailing ₴, and explain each total with its formula directly beneath it.
Do put the primary action within thumb reach above long content, and size touch targets at 36px or more (52px for primary actions).
Do raise elements by stepping up the surface ramp (ground → surface → surface-2 → surface-3) with 1px warm hairlines.
Do pair gain green and loss coral with an arrow, sign or word.
Do use the supplied gold wordmark file as-is in the shell, and the charcoal wordmark (see Home Masthead) on the Home masthead.
Do keep every dialog on the shared ModalRuntime so dialogs centre consistently on phones.
Do mark today and the viewer in tables with the gold haze (gold-wash) in place, keeping the department's order.
Do show every shift code with its letters and a visible legend (The Closed Legend Rule).

Do write all interface copy in Ukrainian, and greet the viewer by first name in the vocative («Добрий вечір, Вікторе»). A name that can't be declined (Latin script, a nickname) stays as written, and with no name the greeting says «колего».
Do keep the gold masthead flat and on Home only, with every element on it in ink on gold.
Do show allergens by name as coral-wash chips with coral text, and flag unreviewed teaching text with the draft note instead of hiding it.
Do render dialogs in a portal with the app shell made inert behind them, through the shared `Overlay` component, and report errors inside the open dialog (The Open Dialog Rule).
Do show people as faces first (photo or initials), grouped in hall order, with the viewer marked in place by an inset gold hairline and «Це ти».
Do upload photos from the device through `src/lib/photo.ts`, resized before upload.
Do keep account state (login, sign-in, archive) admin-only in the API as well as the interface (The Admin Only Account Rule).
Do group the reservations day by time, keep arrival to one tap («Прийшли»), and report a failed tap inside the card that was tapped.

Do compute free tables with the same overlap rule as the server (2 h default, seated until now + 15 min, Kyiv time) and change status through `reserve_status` only (The One Overlap Rule, The Status Only Rule).
Do build pill choices as `aria-pressed` buttons in a labelled group (The Pressed Pill Rule), and give floor state in words in the tile's `aria-label` as well as in colour.
Do give tied values a shared place (1, 1, 3) and let everyone on the best value hold the record (The Shared Place Rule).
Do label half-month records and the cash top with the 1–15 / 16–end split; only the payroll overview keeps its own cash 1–14 rule (The Server Halves Rule).
Do send the live race to Каса · Топ (`/cash?tab=top`) rather than building a second «топ» on Рекорди.
donts: Don't add a light theme; the ground is dark only.
Don't add themed ornament (wine, menu, Georgian folklore or other motifs), gradients, glows or patterns. The edge-fade mask on a sideways-scrolling chip row is a scroll cue, not a painted gradient.
Don't reintroduce the old green palette, wine accent or Prata, or reference the legacy token names (`--bg`, `--gold`, `--green`, …) in new code.

Don't use more than one gold-filled button in a view, or use gold as a section background. The one exception is the Home masthead: on the home page only, a flat #D1B46B field with its text in ink on gold (`--t-on-gold`).
Don't add drop shadows to cards; the segment-thumb shadow is the only one.

Don't show other people's sums in rankings or shared views; show place and movement. The one exception is Рекорди, where every waiter's record value is shown by the owner's decision (The Open Records Rule); it does not extend to Каса · Топ or any other screen.
Don't redraw, re-letter or recolour the Tiflis wordmark beyond the supplied variants. The Home charcoal wordmark matches the supplied charcoal-on-gold variant (see Home Masthead for its provenance).
Don't use the cool bar blue or the shift-code tints outside shift codes. Coral wash keeps its own warning sense for alerts and allergens.
Don't mark a seated booking in gold or a waiting one in green; seated is gain green with «За столом», waiting is neutral in the agenda and gold only as a floor tile.
Don't fade closed bookings with opacity; keep them readable at full opacity and step their text down to text-2 and text-3.
Don't give records medals, podium colours or a gold field; gold on Рекорди is the trophy, the viewer, the «Рекорд ресторану» badge, «Зберегти» and the race link.
